description.to:
As a household member, I want to list my named bots after a Front Door recycle, so I can recover the roster without remembering every bot_id.

Feature: Bot turns pin to the user's computer

Scenario: A user's bots can be listed after a Front Door recycle
  Given an empty control plane backed by a durable messaging store with HTTP
  And tenant "anthus" user "ryan" has a bot named "Researcher"
  And tenant "anthus" user "ryan" has a bot named "Writer"
  When a recycled Front Door serves the same messaging store
  Then tenant "anthus" can list bots for user "ryan":
    | Researcher |
    | Writer     |

Not included: staging, production, Fargate, Safari.
